title: Birth in Englewood, only child, violin at seven, big bands on radio
summary: Stewart was born in Englewood, NJ in 1914, an only child raised strictly. His parents bought him a violin at about seven and he listened to Ellington and Lunceford on the radio.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: The answer -- well, first of all, I was born in Englewood, New Jersey, and that happened September 21st, 1914. So that kind of puts me up there, don't you think?

And, of course, my parents -- I was the only child, and my parents brought me up sort of strict-like. I went to school. I finished high school, of course. During high school years and before I was very interested in music, and as a matter of fact, before I even went to high school, I -- this goes back to the age of around seven years old.

My folks bought me a little violin, and, of course, I used to listen to the big bands on the radio. That was before -- long before TV came in. And I heard some pretty good sounds. Music so interested me, and I was sort of interested in music, listening to the big bands that used to broadcast in

Philadelphia and New York, you know, and Northwest sometimes, and I was able to listen to especially Duke Ellington and -- there were quite a few -- Jimmie Lunceford. And it sort of was -- I was very interested -- the sound really knocked me out, you know.
